explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/163 (the Burr–Erdős conjecture, proved by Lee): for each d ≥ 1 there is C with R(H) ≤ C·|V(H)| for every d-degenerate graph H. IsDegenerate d means every nonempty vertex subset has a vertex of inner degree ≤ d, matching 'every subgraph has a vertex of degree ≤ d'. Formal proof linked.
